audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Ryze and the two-item stage to Illaoi — both backwards, and win[4] contradicted its own whys[4], which says Realm Warp contributes nothing to the 1v1.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Ryze / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Ryze, and the page's own late paragraph calls two items 'your entire win condition'.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Illaoi, two items to Ryze, as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold Level 6 as a duel upgrade, and winCon promised the lane flips 'by the first item'.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a delayed group portal with no combat value, and Illaoi's first item (Sundered Sky / Trinity) is her spike, not yours — the flip is Seraph's plus a second mana item.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten as hers; win condition moved to two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or range appears anywhere on the page (packet reports zero sequencing cues), and the tentacle heal is never named as the reason extended trades fail.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 at 900 range — that is the number the entire page tells you to count. Harsh Lesson is a 4-second, 400-range leap that makes nearby tentacles swing at you, so her gap-close is not the thing to dodge; the spirit pull is. Riot's passive text is explicit that tentacles heal Illaoi when they damage a champion, so Grievous Wounds decides the attrition. Rune Prison also only roots through Spell Flux.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and ranges added, anti-heal tied to the tentacle heal, and the Flux precondition kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: 'Count it out loud if you must' names nothing to count.
audit.corrected: Test of Spirit's 16s rank-1 cooldown now appears in the do-line and the interactions line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Illaoi as 'he' and 'his' throughout while the content layer uses 'she'.
audit.why: The two halves of one page disagree on the opponent's pronouns.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the lines I touched.

notes: Two things for the user. (1) spikes[2] and spikes[3] have their 'when' values swapped — spikes[2] describes the two-item Seraph's spike but is labelled '2+ items' while sitting ahead of spikes[3], which describes her FIRST-item Sundered Sky spike and is labelled '1st item'. The array reads out of order on the page. I did not propose the swap because both strings are under 25 characters and the applier skips those; it needs a direct fix. (2) The Illaoi kit's flags misfire — Leap of Faith carries 'grounding' and 'untargetable' and Test of Spirit carries 'slow', none of which is in Riot's text for those spells — so I wrote no advice on them, matching the mirror.
